summary: Your need for closeness and your need for freedom grind against each other. When someone gets close, part of you wants to run. Your moods can shift fast and surprise even you.
body: Your need for closeness and your need for freedom grind against each other. When someone gets close, part of you wants to run. Your moods can shift fast and surprise even you. This can make depending on people feel unstable until closeness and freedom learn to coexist. So you keep an exit handy and call it independence. That friction is the engine you run on once you see it; it pushes you toward connection that doesn't cost your freedom. The work is staying through the urge to bolt.
gift: At your best: independent, emotionally alive, honest about needing room.
shadow: The trap: bolting when it gets close, then calling the exit independence.
integration: Let emotional needs and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Good for inventive moves and breaking stale routines; poor for steady, predictable handling.
do: Stay through the urge to bolt
Name the need for space before you vanish
dont: Keep an exit handy and call it freedom
Let the mood swing run the show
